description: A man in a blue polo shirt spends a sunny day with his children in a suburban garden and park. He jogs alongside a child in a helmet learning to ride a blue bike, holding the handlebar. He crouches on the grass and lifts a baby high over his head, then sets the baby on his shoulders and stands up, both of them laughing. He plays catch with an older boy who throws a yellow ball back to him, and the shot lifts away over the neighbourhood to a wide green park full of families.

en.question: Who is sitting on the father's shoulders?

de.answer: Das Baby sitzt auf seinen Schultern.
de.question: Wer sitzt auf den Schultern des Vaters?

es.answer: El bebé está sentado sobre sus hombros.
es.question: ¿Quién está sentado sobre los hombros del padre?

fr.answer: Le bébé est assis sur ses épaules.
fr.question: Qui est assis sur les épaules du père ?
